title: Anbe Sivam
desc: When Nalla and Aras get stranded at the airport, Aras tries to keep away from the man with a deformity. However, while forcefully accompanying each other to Chennai, they form an unexpected bond.

title: Veerasamy
desc: Veerasamy, a local lawyer and politician, tries to fight for the rights of the oppressed. However, his life turns difficult when his sister falls in love with a pimp's brother.

title: Enna Petha Raasa
desc: Lakshmi and Raja fall in love and decide to get married. But on the day of the marriage, Raja is accused of murdering a woman.

title: Jeeva
desc: Jeeva, who has a natural talent in cricket, dreams of playing for the Indian cricket team. However, his love life and politics in the sports governing body become obstacles to his ambition.

title: Engal Aasan
desc: Mahendran, a bank officer, is transferred to another branch to control the fraudulent activities of a gangster. However, he suffers a severe setback when the latter burns down the entire bank.
